# Calc

## 1. Addition

1.1 `app.calc.add(a, b)` returns the sum of a and b.

## 2. Multiplication

2.1 `app.calc.mul(a, b)` returns the product of a and b.

## 3. Totals

3.1 `app.calc.total(xs)` returns the sum of the numbers in xs.
